name: The Blues Abide Blueberries
tagline: The Blues Abide Blueberries (formerly Lillegaard Blueberries) — U
description: The Blues Abide Blueberries is a working farm in Gresham, OR. It grows Blueberries, with seasonal availability through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
